svg.title: Baggage handler — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as baggage handler, wearing a safety vest and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Two handled suitcases of different heights rest on a low luggage trolley with two separate wheels. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
